items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section I, List of Answers on Terminology 27:1
items.html: Every cause is called an “Emanator” with respect to the degree that is its consequence. The name Emanator includes both the extension of the light and the vessel that receives the light.
